tldr: Venus in the 2nd house: love becomes personal through money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
body:
With Venus in the 2nd house, this part of you moves through money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady. Venus describes love, attraction, pleasure, beauty, values, and what makes connection feel worth choosing. In practice, this brings attention to what you earn, keep, choose, spend, protect, and come to understand as worth your energy.

When this placement is supported, you can build a steadier relationship with what supports you. Venus can become warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, and the ability to attract support.

When it is strained, comfort, spending, fear, or self-protection can start making choices for you. The harder pattern can show up as people-pleasing, avoidance, indulgence, or measuring worth through approval.
gift: warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, and the ability to attract support expressed through money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
challenge: people-pleasing, avoidance, indulgence, or measuring worth through approval around money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
